name: Can I replace just one pane of a double-pane window if the seal fails?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace just one pane of a double-pane window if the seal fails?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you cannot replace just one pane of a double-pane window if the seal fails. The two panes of glass, along with the spacer and sealant, form a factory-sealed insulated glass unit (IGU). When the seal fails, the entire IGU must be replaced as a single unit. Attempting to separate and replace one pane would destroy the integrity and insulating properties of the unit.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, if the seal fails in a double-pane window, the entire insulated glass unit (IGU) must be replaced.
